map.输入面料幅宽、排料长度与样片总面积，计算裁剪排版利用率: Input fabric width, marker length and total piece area to compute cutting layout utilization
map.💡 利用率 = 样片总面积 ÷（幅宽 × 排料长度）× 100%: 💡 Utilization = total piece area ÷ (width × marker length) × 100%
map.幅宽单位 cm，排料长度单位 m，样片面积单位 m²: Width in cm, marker length in m, piece area in m²
map.利用率越高越省料，优秀排版可达 85% 以上: Higher utilization saves material; excellent layouts exceed 85%
map.排料后核算布料利用率，优化单耗降本: After layout, check fabric utilization and optimize unit consumption to reduce cost
map.不同幅宽/件数方案对比，选利用率最高者: Compare different width/piece-count plans, pick the highest utilization
map.利用率低于阈值时调整排料或换窄幅布: When utilization falls below threshold, adjust layout or switch to narrower fabric
map.布料 1.5 m × 2 m = 3 m²，裁片净面积合计 2.55 m² →: Fabric 1.5 m × 2 m = 3 m², net piece area 2.55 m² → utilization = 2.55 / 3 = 85% (good).
map.同版型用 150 cm 幅宽利用率 85%、用 120 cm 幅宽降至 72%: Same pattern at 150 cm width 85% vs 120 cm width 72% → narrower is cheaper but raises unit use, price comprehensively.
map.一般裁床利用率 80%–90%，格料/对花偏低；低于 80% 应重排或审版型。: Generally cutting utilization 80%-90%, checks/matching lower; below 80% re-layout or review pattern.
map.利用率和单耗什么关系？: How does utilization relate to unit consumption?
map.单耗 = 布面积 / (件数 × 利用率)，利用率越高单耗越低、成本越低。: Unit use = fabric area / (pieces × utilization); higher utilization lowers unit use and cost.
map.裁剪排版利用率反映面料使用的经济性，是服装成本控制的关键指标。本工具根据面料幅宽: Cutting layout utilization reflects fabric economy, a key metric for apparel cost control. This tool quickly computes utilization and loss rate from fabric width, marker length and total piece area, helping optimize layout plans and reduce fabric cost.
map.利用率与损耗率同步计算: Utilization and loss rate computed together
